info.title: Blocknet Daemon API
info.description: Network upgrade notice: Blocknet plans a network upgrade around 2027-02-16. After it, you will have 1 year to move your coins to the new format, until about 2028-02-16. Coins not moved by then cannot be spent. The wallet will guide you. JSON API for the Blocknet privacy blockchain daemon. The API starts when the core runs with `--api <addr>`. Private endpoints require Bearer token authentication with the token in `<dataDir>/api.cookie`, written on startup. Public blockchain routes (`GET /api/health`, `/api/status`, `/api/block/{id}`, `/api/tx/{hash}`, `/api/mempool`, `/api/mempool/txs`, `/api/peers`, `/api/peers/banned`, `/api/stats`, and `POST /api/verify`, `/api/verify-proof`) need no token. Node settings are read and changed with `GET` and `PATCH /api/settings`.

servers.description: Local daemon (mantle default for --api on mainnet)

patch.description: Changes only the fields in the body and saves them to <dataDir>/settings.json. A field set to null goes back to its default. Live fields apply at once. The others are listed in restart_required. Unknown fields are rejected. Requires Bearer token.

get.description: Searches mempool first (fast), then the transaction index (a chain scan is used only while the index is still building). Returns the transaction with confirmation count and mempool status.

404.description: Transaction not found in mempool or chain

Returns all currently unconfirmed mempool transactions as full transaction objects in a JSON array. Each item matches the same `Transaction` schema returned by `GET /api/tx/{hash}`. Returns an empty array when the mempool is empty.

post.description: Verifies a Schnorr signature (Ristretto255) against a Blocknet stealth address. Does not require a wallet — uses only stateless cryptographic verification. Useful for 'login with Blocknet' flows where any node can validate a signature produced by `POST /api/wallet/sign`. Rate-limited per IP.

valid.description: True if the signature is valid for the given address and message

value.error: invalid signature: must be 64 bytes hex-encoded

get.description: Returns chain, network, and emission/economics statistics as numeric JSON. All amounts are in atomic units (smallest units). Values are a deterministic function of the chain tip and require no wallet.

post.description: Verifies a sender's payment proof. Given a transaction id, the deterministic transaction private key (`tx_key` from `POST /api/wallet/prove`), and a recipient address, confirms the `tx_key` genuinely belongs to the transaction (`valid`) and reveals which of its outputs that address received, with amounts (atomic units) and any memo. Stateless — no wallet required. Rate-limited per IP.

200.description: Verification result. `valid` is false when the tx_key does not correspond to the transaction; per-output `match` indicates which outputs the address received.

valid.summary: Valid proof, one output received by the address

invalid.summary: tx_key does not match the transaction

post.description: Loads an existing wallet from disk, decrypting with the given password. The node always starts without a wallet, so a client calls this (or create/import) first. If `filepath` is provided, only the basename is used and the file is resolved in the folder of the `wallet_file` setting; if omitted, `wallet_file` itself is loaded. After loading, the wallet is unlocked, all wallet endpoints become available, and miner reward keys are pointed at this wallet. If blocks arrived while the wallet was offline, a background scan is started automatically — check `synced_height` vs `chain_height` in the response or the balance endpoint to track progress. Returns 409 while a wallet is loaded or another load is running. After `POST /api/wallet/unload` it can be called again.

password.description: Wallet encryption password (min 3 characters). Used to decrypt the wallet file.

filepath.description: Optional wallet file name. Only the base name is used: any folder part is dropped. The file goes in the folder of the `wallet_file` setting (see `PATCH /api/settings`). Defaults to the `wallet_file` setting.

filename.description: Basename of the loaded wallet file

chain_height.description: Current chain tip height. If synced_height < chain_height, a background scan is in progress.

value.error: password must be at least 3 characters

401.description: Missing or invalid Bearer token (text/plain), or wrong wallet password (JSON)

404.description: Wallet file not found at the resolved path

422.description: Wallet file is corrupted or unreadable

post.description: Generates a new wallet with a fresh BIP39 seed, encrypts it with the given password, and saves it to disk. The wallet is loaded and unlocked in the running daemon. Since this is a brand-new wallet, no chain scanning is needed — the synced height is set to the current chain tip. Can only be called when no wallet is currently loaded (returns 409 otherwise). If `filename` is provided, only the basename is used and the file is placed in the folder of the `wallet_file` setting; if omitted, `wallet_file` itself is used. Will not overwrite an existing file.

password.description: Encryption password for the wallet file (min 3 characters).

filename.description: Optional wallet file name. Only the base name is used: any folder part is dropped. The file goes in the folder of the `wallet_file` setting (see `PATCH /api/settings`). Defaults to the `wallet_file` setting.
Basename of the created wallet file

post.description: Locks and unloads the currently loaded wallet, releasing all in-memory key material. After this call the node returns to the same state as before load was called — wallet endpoints that need a wallet return 503 until one is loaded again with load, create or import. Mining reward keys are cleared. No request body required.

post.summary: Import wallet from recovery seed or keys
post.description: Creates a new wallet from exactly one source: a BIP39 12-word recovery seed (`mnemonic`), hex private keys (`spend_priv` + `view_priv`), or a view-only key pair (`spend_pub` + `view_priv`, which makes a wallet that can watch but not spend). It encrypts it with the given password, and saves it to disk. The wallet is loaded and unlocked in the running daemon and a background scan of the entire blockchain is started to find outputs belonging to this seed. Check `synced_height` vs `chain_height` in the response or the balance endpoint to track progress. Can only be called when no wallet is currently loaded (returns 409 otherwise). If `filename` is provided, only the basename is used and the file is placed in the same directory as the folder of the `wallet_file` setting; if omitted, the default wallet path is used. Will not overwrite an existing file.

spend_priv.description: Spend private key, 64 hex chars. Use with view_priv.

view_priv.description: View private key, 64 hex chars. Use with spend_priv, or with spend_pub for a view-only wallet.

spend_pub.description: Spend public key, 64 hex chars. Use with view_priv for a view-only wallet.

password.description: Encryption password for the wallet file (min 3 characters)

filename.description: Optional wallet file name. Only the base name is used: any folder part is dropped. The file goes in the folder of the `wallet_file` setting (see `PATCH /api/settings`). Defaults to the `wallet_file` setting.

get.description: Returns spendable, pending, and total confirmed balance in atomic units (1 BNT = 100,000,000 atomic units). Spendable counts only mature outputs: coinbase outputs need coinbase maturity, and regular outputs need 10 confirmations. Also includes an optional UX-only `pending_unconfirmed` amount (typically change from your most recent send) plus an estimated unlock ETA in seconds, assuming ~5 minute blocks. If the wallet is more than 100 blocks behind the chain (background scan in progress), balance numbers are omitted and `scanning: true` is returned with progress info instead. Requires unlocked wallet.
Returns the wallet's public stealth address (base58 of spend_pub || view_pub || 4-byte checksum, 68 bytes). Senders derive unique one-time addresses from this. Requires unlocked wallet.

address.description: Base58-encoded stealth address (spend_pub || view_pub || 4-byte checksum, 68 raw bytes)

view_only.description: True if this wallet can only scan for incoming funds, not spend

get.description: Returns every wallet output, spent and immature ones included, with amounts, block heights, coinbase flag, and spent status. Requires unlocked wallet.

Same wallet outputs as GET /api/wallet/history, but returned newest-first in deterministic pages so busy wallets do not have to ship their entire output set at once. Ordering is stable across pages: pending outputs (block_height 0) first, then descending block height, then txid, then output index. Page with limit/offset and use the total field to know when to stop. The unpaginated /api/wallet/history endpoint remains available and unchanged. Requires unlocked wallet.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of outputs to return. Values above 500 are clamped to 500.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of sorted outputs to skip.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort direction. desc is newest-first (pending, then descending block height); asc reverses it. Ties break by txid then output index.

example.error: order must be asc or desc

get.description: Returns outbound payments recorded by the loaded wallet. This is wallet-local send metadata: recipient addresses and memos are available because the wallet recorded them at send time. Chain lookup is used only to annotate each tx as confirmed, mempool, or not_found. Requires unlocked wallet.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of sends to return. Values above 500 are clamped to 500.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of sorted send records to skip.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort direction by wallet-recorded send timestamp. Ties are sorted by txid.

get.summary: All wallet outputs with full detail
get.description: Returns every output owned by the wallet with computed status (spent/unspent/pending), confirmations, type, cryptographic keys, and summary counts. Sorted ascending by block height, then txid, then output index. Requires unlocked wallet.

post.description: Builds a privacy-preserving transaction with one or more recipients using RingCT (Pedersen commitments, Bulletproofs range proofs, CLSAG ring signatures with fixed ring size 16), submits to mempool, and broadcasts via Dandelion++. Fee is calculated as max(min_fee, fee_per_byte * tx_size). Note: multi-recipient transactions link all recipients within the same transaction from a graph-analysis perspective. Requires unlocked full wallet (not view-only).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional idempotency key for retry-safe client behavior (max 128 chars). A repeat with the same key and the same JSON body replays the stored response, success or error, for 30 days (up to 4096 keys). 429 responses are not stored. Reusing a key with a different body returns 409. If the node stopped while the request was running, its outcome is unknown: the key shows state `accepted` in the status route and returns 409 with an interrupted message until it expires.

post.description: Builds a transaction with one or more recipients using caller-specified inputs (coin control). The caller selects which outputs to spend by referencing txid + output_index pairs from GET /api/wallet/outputs. No automatic input selection is performed. Supports dry_run mode to preview fee and change before broadcasting. Optional change_split (1-4) distributes change across multiple outputs for improved back-to-back send concurrency at the cost of reduced privacy. Same fee calculation, ring signatures, and Dandelion++ broadcast as the standard send endpoint.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional idempotency key for retry-safe client behavior (max 128 chars). A repeat with the same key and the same JSON body replays the stored response, success or error, for 30 days (up to 4096 keys). 429 responses are not stored. Reusing a key with a different body returns 409. If the node stopped while the request was running, its outcome is unknown: the key shows state `accepted` in the status route and returns 409 with an interrupted message until it expires.

post.summary: Audit key images for burned funds
post.description: Scans all wallet outputs and groups them by key image. Outputs that share a key image are duplicates caused by a historical self-send key derivation bug — only one output per group can ever be spent, the rest are permanently unspendable (burned). No request body required. Requires loaded, unlocked wallet.

post.description: Appends checkpoints (block height + hash, every 100 blocks) to `<dataDir>/checkpoints.dat`, resuming after the last one already written. Only finalized heights are written: up to the chain tip minus 100 blocks, rounded down to a multiple of 100. If no height is final yet, it writes nothing and returns `message: "chain is empty, nothing to save"`. Checkpoints let nodes fast-sync by skipping proof-of-work re-verification at or below the checkpointed height. Requires Bearer token.

200.description: Checkpoints written (or already up to date)

written.description: Number of checkpoints appended this call

last_checkpoint.description: Height of the highest checkpoint on disk

message.description: Present when nothing was written (empty chain or already up to date)

500.description: Failed to write the checkpoints file

post.description: Downloads the checkpoints file if not present, loads it, and registers the checkpoints as trusted so blocks at or below the maximum checkpoint height can skip proof-of-work re-verification during sync. Requires Bearer token.

downloaded.description: True if the file was fetched from the remote this call

fast_sync.description: True if the chain is below max_height and can fast-sync

message.description: Present when no checkpoints were found

502.description: Checkpoints file could not be downloaded or saved locally

get.description: Walks the entire chain and checks every block's difficulty (LWMA), timestamp rules, and prev-hash linkage. This is an arithmetic-only check (no Argon2id PoW re-hashing), so it completes in seconds. Returns all violations found, or confirms the chain is clean.

clean.description: True if no violations were found

violations.description: List of violations. Omitted when the chain is clean.

height.description: Block height where the violation was detected

get.description: Returns mining state, thread count, and stats (hashrate, hash count, blocks found, start time) when running. Hashrate and stat fields are omitted when the miner is stopped.

post.description: Starts the Argon2id proof-of-work miner. Load a wallet first: the miner pays the wallet that was loaded when the core started mining, and with no wallet the coinbase pays throwaway keys and the reward is lost. The miner waits until it has at least one peer. Each thread allocates ~2GB RAM. No request body required.
Stops the miner. No request body required.
Sets the number of mining threads. Each thread uses ~2GB RAM for Argon2id. Takes effect immediately if the miner is running.

threads.description: Number of mining threads, from 1 to the number of CPU cores. A larger value returns 400 "threads must be <= N".

get.summary: Get block template for pool mining
get.description: Returns a complete block template ready for proof-of-work solving. Includes a pre-built coinbase transaction (paying to the loaded wallet by default, or to the optional `address` override), selected mempool transactions, and the computed merkle root. The `target` field (hex) is the PoW target that the Argon2id hash must be less than. The `header_base` field (hex) is the 92-byte serialized header without the nonce. PoW hash = Argon2id(password = nonce as 8 bytes little-endian, salt = header_base bytes), 32-byte output. The `block` field is the raw consensus form (PascalCase header keys, byte arrays as integer arrays), not the `GET /api/block` summary. The `template_id` field identifies this template and can be used with compact submit payloads (`template_id` + `nonce`) via `POST /api/mining/submitblock`. Its compact-submission lease expires at `template_expires_at_unix_ms`; clients may extend a live, current-tip lease with `POST /api/mining/renewtemplate`. The daemon retains at most 512 live leases for one tip and returns 503 rather than evicting a lease before its advertised expiry. Requires a loaded wallet (for coinbase keys) but does not require it to be unlocked.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Optional reward address override. If provided, the coinbase output pays to this stealth address instead of the loaded wallet address.

503.description: A template cannot currently be served because no wallet is loaded, the node is syncing, the chain tip changed during construction, or all 512 same-tip lease slots are live. Capacity responses include Retry-After with the number of seconds until the earliest lease expiry.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the earliest live template lease expires. Present for mining_template_cache_full responses.

value.error: chain tip changed while building template, retry
mining template cache full, retry after a lease expires or the chain tip changes

post.description: Extends the compact-submission lease of an unexpired cached template. Renewal succeeds only while the template still builds directly on the current canonical chain tip. This does not rebuild or otherwise change the template.

404.description: The template ID is unknown or its lease has expired

409.description: The template no longer builds on the current canonical tip

example.error: template no longer builds on current tip

post.description: Accepts a solved block (from pool mining or an external miner). Send either the full block in the raw consensus form (see `RawBlock`, as returned in `GET /api/mining/blocktemplate`) or a compact `template_id` + `nonce`. The block must pass full validation: correct height, prev hash linking to the current tip, valid difficulty, valid Argon2id proof-of-work, valid merkle root, and valid transactions. On success the block is broadcast to peers and `mined_block` subscribers are notified. `accepted: true` is also returned when the block is valid but lands on a side chain. Rate limit: 2 requests/s per IP (burst 4), 2 at a time.

application/json.description: Either a complete block object with a valid nonce, or a compact payload containing `template_id` and `nonce`.

rejected.summary: Failed validation (details are logged, not returned)

stale.summary: Block is for an old tip

bad_json.summary: Body is not valid JSON or not a block

bad_template.summary: Template lease is unknown or expired

post.description: Deletes all blockchain data from disk. Requires explicit confirmation. Stops the daemon, removes the data directory (chain database, checkpoints file, send idempotency records and the API cookie), keeps `settings.json`, then shuts down the API server. A restart is required after this operation. This is irreversible.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm the destructive operation

example.message: blockchain data purged successfully, restart required

get.description: Server-Sent Events stream for real-time updates. On connection, emits a `connected` event with current chain state. Then streams `new_block` for every new block added to the chain and `mined_block` for every block accepted through `POST /api/mining/submitblock` or the built-in miner. Sends SSE comment keepalives every 30s. Write timeout is disabled for this long-lived connection.

keepalive.summary: SSE comment sent every 30s to keep connection alive

bearerAuth.description: Token read from `<dataDir>/api.cookie`. Generated fresh on every daemon startup using `crypto/rand` (32 bytes, hex-encoded = 64 chars). File has 0600 permissions. Deleted on graceful shutdown.

listen.description: P2P listen multiaddr. Applies after restart.

seed.description: Seed mode with a fixed identity. Applies after restart.

full_sync.description: Ignore checkpoints and verify the whole chain. Applies after restart. Always on for testnet.

save_checkpoints.description: Append a checkpoint every 100 finalized blocks. Applies now.

explorer_addr.description: Explorer HTTP address. Empty turns the explorer off. Applies now.

wallet_file.description: Default wallet file. Its folder holds every wallet the API loads, creates or imports. Applies now.

p2p_max_inbound.description: Max inbound peers, 0 = default. Applies after restart.

p2p_max_outbound.description: Max outbound peers, 0 = default. Applies after restart.

p2p_whitelist.description: Peer IDs that are never banned. Applies now.

extra_peers.description: Extra peer multiaddrs to dial at startup. Applies after restart.

identity_key_path.description: Path of a fixed P2P identity key. Empty uses the seed default or an ephemeral identity. Applies after restart.

chain_cache_cap.description: Blocks kept in memory, 0 = default. Applies after restart.

Settings.description: Node settings saved in `<dataDir>/settings.json`. In a PATCH body, a field set to null goes back to its default. Responses never contain null.

code.description: Optional stable machine-readable error code. Clients should prefer this over matching the human-readable error string when present.

mempool_generation.description: Monotonic mempool content generation used by mining clients to detect template changes

syncing.description: True if the node is currently syncing blocks from peers

sync_progress.description: Blocks synced so far in the current sync. Only present while syncing.

sync_target.description: Target height of the current sync. Only present while syncing.

sync_percent.description: Sync progress as a percent string such as "12.3%". Only present while syncing.

identity_age.description: Duration since last P2P identity rotation (e.g. "2h34m12s")

WalletDiagnostics.description: Wallet version and format metadata for troubleshooting. Only present when the wallet is unlocked.

enc_format.description: Encryption envelope format (legacy = no header, v1 = BLKNTWLT header)

kdf_version.description: KDF parameter profile version (0 = legacy 64 MiB, 1 = current 256 MiB)

created_at.description: Unix timestamp of wallet creation (0 if predates this field)

has_mnemonic.description: True if the wallet contains a BIP39 mnemonic

address_format.description: Address encoding format (legacy = 64-byte no checksum, checksummed = 68-byte with checksum)

file_size_bytes.description: Encrypted wallet file size in bytes

merkle_root.description: Merkle root of transactions (64 hex chars)

tx_count.description: Number of transactions in the block

transactions.description: Transaction summaries (first tx is coinbase for height > 0)

reward.description: Block reward in atomic units (smooth exponential decay to 2.0 BNT tail)

fee.description: Fee in atomic units (0 for coinbase)

Bytes8.description: 8-byte value encoded as a JSON array of integers [0..255]. This matches Go's default JSON encoding for `[8]byte`.

Bytes32.description: 32-byte value encoded as a JSON array of integers [0..255]. This matches Go's default JSON encoding for `[32]byte`.

Bytes128.description: 128-byte value encoded as a JSON array of integers [0..255]. This matches Go's default JSON encoding for `[128]byte` (used for `encrypted_memo`).

ring_members.description: Ring member one-time public keys (real + decoys)

ring_commitments.description: Pedersen commitments for each ring member

range_proof.description: Base64-encoded Bulletproof range proof bytes (omitted in some contexts)

inputs.description: Transaction inputs. null for a coinbase transaction read from the chain.

RawBlockHeader.description: Block header in Go's default JSON form. Keys are PascalCase and hashes are 32-integer arrays.

RawBlock.description: Full block in the raw consensus JSON form used by mining.

transactions.description: Coinbase first, then the selected mempool transactions

tx.description: Full transaction object. NOTE: byte arrays are encoded as JSON arrays of integers (Go default encoding).

block_height.description: Block height containing the tx (absent when in_mempool is true)

confirmations.description: Number of confirmations (0 when in mempool)

in_mempool.description: True if the tx is unconfirmed in the mempool

generation.description: Monotonic content generation; changes whenever transactions are added or removed

min_fee.description: Lowest fee in the mempool (atomic units, 0 when empty)

max_fee.description: Highest fee in the mempool (atomic units, 0 when empty)

StatsResponse.description: Chain, network, and emission statistics. Amounts are in atomic units (smallest units).

difficulty.description: Difficulty target for the next block (LWMA)

network_hashrate.description: Estimated network hashrate (hashes/sec) over recent blocks; 0 with insufficient history

avg_block_time.description: Average block time (seconds) over recent blocks; 0 with insufficient history

block_reward.description: Coinbase reward at the current height (atomic units)

emitted.description: Cumulative coins emitted through the current height (atomic units)

remaining.description: Coins remaining toward target_supply; 0 once tail emission is reached (atomic units)

target_supply.description: Approximate emission before tail emission begins (~100M coins, atomic units)

months_to_tail.description: Months of decay before tail emission begins

blocks_per_month.description: Blocks per month at the target interval

MempoolTransactions.description: Array of unconfirmed transactions currently in the mempool.

addrs.description: Remote multiaddrs of active connections to this peer
Last known multiaddrs at ban time

ban_count.description: Number of times this peer has been banned

permanent.description: True if ban does not expire

BalanceResponse.description: When `scanning` is true, only `synced_height` and `chain_height` are present — balance fields are omitted until the wallet catches up.

scanning.description: True if wallet is more than 100 blocks behind the chain (background scan in progress)

spendable.description: Mature, spendable balance in atomic units (omitted while scanning)

pending.description: Unspent outputs that are not mature yet: coinbase outputs before maturity and regular outputs with fewer than 10 confirmations (atomic units, omitted while scanning)

pending_unconfirmed.description: Unconfirmed expected credits not yet scanned from a block (typically change from your most recent send). UX-only; not part of confirmed balance totals (atomic units). Omitted while scanning.

pending_unconfirmed_eta.description: Estimated seconds until `pending_unconfirmed` becomes spendable, assuming ~5 minute blocks and requiring next block + 10 confirmations. 0 when no pending_unconfirmed. Omitted while scanning.

total.description: Total unspent balance: spendable + pending (atomic units, omitted while scanning)

outputs_total.description: Total output count (including spent, omitted while scanning)

outputs_unspent.description: Currently unspent output count (omitted while scanning)

memo_decrypt_failures.description: Number of outputs where memo decryption failed (omitted while scanning)

memo_decrypt_last_height.description: Block height of the most recent memo decryption failure (omitted while scanning)

block_height.description: Block height where this output was confirmed

is_coinbase.description: True if this is a mining reward output

spent.description: True if already used as an input

spent_height.description: Block height where spent (omitted if unspent, 0 means unspent)

memo_hex.description: Hex-encoded decrypted memo payload (present only when the output carried a non-empty memo). Max 248 hex chars (124 bytes).

status.description: Computed status: spent (already used), unspent (mature, spendable), pending (immature, awaiting confirmations)

type.description: Output type: coinbase (mining reward) or regular (transfer)

block_height.description: Block height where this output was confirmed

spent_height.description: Block height where spent (omitted if unspent)

memo_hex.description: Hex-encoded decrypted memo payload (present only when the output carried a non-empty memo). Max 248 hex chars (124 bytes).

address.description: Recipient address recorded by the sending wallet

memo_hex.description: Hex-encoded memo recorded for this recipient, if any

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp recorded by the wallet when the send was created

recorded_height.description: Chain height recorded by the wallet at send time. This is not necessarily the confirmation block height.

chain_state.description: Current daemon lookup state for the transaction hash

in_mempool.description: True when the transaction is currently in the daemon mempool

fee.description: Fee recorded by the wallet in atomic units

total_amount.description: Sum of recorded recipient amounts in atomic units

recipients.description: Recipient metadata recorded locally by the sending wallet

count.description: Number of sends returned in this response

total.description: Total wallet send records available before pagination

count.description: Number of outputs returned in this response

total.description: Total wallet outputs available before pagination

signature.description: Hex-encoded 64-byte Schnorr signature over Ristretto255 (128 hex chars)

message.description: The message that was signed (max 1024 bytes of UTF-8)

signature.description: Hex-encoded 64-byte Schnorr signature over Ristretto255 (128 hex chars), as returned by `POST /api/wallet/sign`

tx_key.description: Deterministic transaction private key from POST /api/wallet/prove (64 hex characters)

valid.description: True if tx_key corresponds to the transaction's public key

total_matched.description: Sum of amounts the address received in this transaction (atomic units)

match.description: True if this output was received by the address

amount.description: Amount received (atomic units); present only when match is true

memo.description: Decrypted memo, if any; present only when match is true

address.description: Recipient stealth address (base58-encoded spend_pub || view_pub) or Blocknet ID handle

memo_text.description: Optional UTF-8 memo text. Mutually exclusive with memo_hex. Server enforces max 124 BYTES after UTF-8 encoding.

memo_hex.description: Optional memo payload in hex. Mutually exclusive with memo_text. Max 248 hex chars (124 bytes).

address.description: Address as provided in the request

resolved_handle.description: Handle that was resolved (if address was a Blocknet ID)

recipients.description: One or more recipients. Total amount must not exceed spendable balance.

dry_run.description: If true, estimate the fee and return a preview without broadcasting. No transaction is created.

txid.description: Transaction hash (64 hex chars). Absent when dry_run is true.

fee.description: Fee paid (or estimated) in atomic units

change.description: Change returned to wallet in atomic units

dry_run.description: Whether this was a dry run (fee preview only)

input_total.description: Total value of selected inputs in atomic units. Present when dry_run is true.

input_count.description: Number of inputs selected. Present when dry_run is true.

recipients.description: Per-recipient results including any handle resolution info and memos

state.description: Persisted send state. accepted means the daemon durably recorded the request but does not have a terminal result yet.

created_at.description: When the daemon first accepted the idempotent request.

updated_at.description: When the daemon last updated the persisted state.

original_status.description: HTTP status returned by the original send request when a terminal result exists.

recipients.description: One or more recipients. The sum of specified inputs must cover total amount plus the computed fee.

txid.description: Transaction ID of the output to spend (64 hex chars). Obtain from GET /api/wallet/outputs.

output_index.description: Output index within the transaction. Obtain from GET /api/wallet/outputs.

inputs.description: Specific outputs to use as transaction inputs. No automatic selection is performed. Each output must be unspent, mature, unreserved, and not have its key image in the mempool.

dry_run.description: If true, validate inputs and compute fee/change without building or broadcasting the transaction. The reserved inputs are released immediately.

change_split.description: Number of change outputs to create (1-4). The core treats 0 or less as 1. Higher values improve back-to-back send concurrency at the cost of reduced privacy (deviates from the standard 2-output transaction fingerprint). The actual count is min(change_split, change in atomic units), and 0 when there is no change.

txid.description: Transaction hash (64 hex chars). Absent in dry_run mode.

fee.description: Fee in atomic units (computed as max(min_fee, fee_per_byte * estimated_size))

change.description: Change returned to wallet in atomic units

change_split.description: Number of change outputs: min(change_split, change), and 0 when there is no change. For a dry run, the number that would be created.

input_total.description: Sum of all specified input amounts in atomic units

dry_run.description: True if this was a dry-run preview (no transaction was broadcast)

recipients.description: Per-recipient results including any handle resolution info and memos

state.description: Persisted send state. accepted means the daemon durably recorded the request but does not have a terminal result yet.

created_at.description: When the daemon first accepted the idempotent request.

updated_at.description: When the daemon last updated the persisted state.

original_status.description: HTTP status returned by the original send request when a terminal result exists.

block.description: Complete block with nonce=0, in the raw consensus JSON form (not the `GET /api/block` summary). Submit back with a valid nonce via POST /api/mining/submitblock, or send only `template_id` + `nonce`.

target.description: Hex-encoded 32-byte PoW target (64 hex chars). The Argon2id hash for a nonce must be less than this value, compared as a big-endian number.

header_base.description: Hex-encoded 92-byte serialized header without the nonce. PoW = Argon2id(password = nonce as 8 bytes little-endian, salt = header_base bytes), 32-byte output. The nonce is not appended to header_base.

reward_address_used.description: The stealth address used for the coinbase output in this template. Mirrors the `address` query parameter if provided; otherwise it is the loaded wallet address.

template_id.description: Opaque template identifier used for compact submit payloads (`template_id` + `nonce`).

template_expires_at_unix_ms.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the compact-submission lease expires. Renew with POST /api/mining/renewtemplate before this instant to keep using the same template ID.

mempool_generation.description: Exact mempool generation represented by the template transaction selection. Compare with /api/status mempool_generation to detect same-tip content changes.

template_id.description: Unexpired template ID returned by GET /api/mining/blocktemplate.

template_expires_at_unix_ms.description: New compact-submission lease expiry as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

nonce.description: PoW nonce found for the referenced template.

running.description: Whether the miner is currently active

hashrate.description: Hashes per second (only present when running)

hash_count.description: Total hashes computed this session (only present when running)

blocks_found.description: Blocks mined this session (only present when running)

started_at.description: RFC3339 miner start time (only present when running)

BadRequest.description: Invalid request parameters or malformed JSON

NoWallet.description: No wallet loaded on this node. Call `POST /api/wallet/load`, `/api/wallet/create` or `/api/wallet/import` first.

tags.name: Wallet
tags.description: Balance, address, history, and sending. The node always starts without a wallet. Call `POST /api/wallet/load`, `/api/wallet/create` or `/api/wallet/import` first. Wallet files live in the folder of the `wallet_file` setting. Most other wallet endpoints need a loaded, unlocked wallet. `lock`, `unlock`, `send/status` and `send/advanced/status` do not need it unlocked.
